items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk. ... [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Whatever you like.
